svg.text: Cut 650 mm of 160 x 2 mm plain steel pipe; square the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rod holes: two 11 mm holes opposite each other, 15 mm above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stop clips: three 20 mm lengths of 20 x 20 x 3 mm angle, each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: riveted (two 4.8 mm rivets) by its upright leg to the pipe, 120

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: degrees apart, with the flat leg's underside 50 mm above the foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the foot slides 50 mm into the jacket sleeve; the clips rest

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the sleeve rim and carry the flue and the baffle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap leg rivet holes: see CCB-DWG-113.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: drops into a 164 mm bore to the clips without forcing.
